meta.title: English Boarding Pass — English That Takes You Places
meta.description: Live online English classes for Sri Lankan students. Learn from Sinhala or Tamil with experienced Sri Lankan teachers — 40 live classes, real conversation practice, a certificate at the end.

hero.eyebrow: Live online English classes · Sri Lanka
hero.title: English that takes you places.
hero.subtitle: Want to speak English with confidence? Learn live, online, with experienced Sri Lankan teachers — taught in the language you already think in.

routes.title: Choose your route
routes.subtitle: Two direct routes to confident spoken English. Pick the one that starts where you are — no levels to guess, no placement test.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: No passive watching. No guessing what to do next. Just a clear path from your first class to a certificate you earned.

steps.title: Two live classes a week
steps.description: Real Sri Lankan teachers, live on screen — not pre-recorded videos. Twice a week, every week, for five months.

steps.title: You speak every class
steps.description: This isn't a lecture you watch. Every class is built around you talking — answering, practising, getting it wrong, and trying again.

steps.title: Finish 40 classes, get certified
steps.description: Complete all 40 classes and leave with a certificate and a mock interview, so you know exactly how far you've come.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, no surprises
pricing.subtitle: One price for the full 5-month route. No hidden fees, no upsells.
pricing.fine: Covers all 40 live classes, class materials, and your certificate. Seats confirmed on payment.

testimonials.title: Students who found their words
testimonials.subtitle: Real students, real progress. Photos and stories to follow as our first cohorts graduate.

items.quote: I used to freeze in interviews. After a few weeks of actually speaking every class, I stopped translating in my head and just answered.
items.name: Nimasha P.

items.quote: Having the teacher explain in Tamil first meant nothing felt out of reach. By class 20 I was arguing my own opinions in English.
items.name: Aravind S.

items.quote: Small batch, so the teacher actually knew my name and where I kept getting stuck. That made all the difference.
items.name: Dilshan K.

teachers.title: Learn from teachers who get it
teachers.subtitle: Experienced Sri Lankan English teachers who know exactly where Sinhala and Tamil speakers get stuck — because they've taught this journey before.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Message us on WhatsApp — we reply fast.

items.question: Do I need to know any English to start?
items.answer: No. Classes are taught with Sinhala or Tamil explanations from day one, so you can start from wherever you are right now.

items.question: What if I miss a class?
items.answer: Let your teacher know and we'll help you catch up before the next one. Because batches are small, teachers notice when you're behind and help you keep pace.

items.question: Are the classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Live, always. Every class is taught by a real teacher in real time, because speaking practice only works when someone is actually listening and responding.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Pay the full amount, or split it into two interest-free instalments. Your seat is confirmed once payment is made.

items.question: Is there a certificate at the end?
items.answer: Yes. Finish all 40 classes and you'll get a certificate and a mock interview, so you leave with proof of how far you've come.

items.question: What if I'm too nervous to speak in class?
items.answer: That's normal, and it's exactly what we're here for. Batches stay small so your teacher can bring you in gently — mistakes are expected, not judged.

finalCta.title: Ready for takeoff?
finalCta.subtitle: Seats are limited to keep every class small enough that you actually get heard.
